race.title: Race And Stay Irish EBF Beginners Chase
race.verdict: A most interesting beginners chase with the narrow vote in favour of CLASSICAL CREEK . Absent since finishing down the field in Grade 1 company over hurdles at Naas in January, his profile prior to that was a most positive one and firmly appealing as the type to make an even better chaser, he can enhance his yard's solid recent record in this race. Fruit de Mer and Kopeck de Mee are others making plenty of appeal, with Forty Coats rounding off the shortlist. CLASSICAL CREEK FRUIT DE MER (IRE) KOPECK DE MEE (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Fruit De Mer (13/8), Classical Creek (2/1), Kopeck De Mee (7/2), Espresso Milan (5/1), Kazansky (15/2), Forty Coats (12/1), Hens Tooth (28/1), Big Tom (200/1), Lengaruka (300/1)
